question: CBNAAT (GeneXpert MTB/RIF) simultaneously detects Mycobacterium tuberculosis AND rifampicin resistance in the same test run.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This is TRUE. CBNAAT (GeneXpert MTB/RIF) uses molecular probes to detect both MTB DNA and rpoB gene mutations conferring rifampicin resistance simultaneously in ~2 hours. It is the recommended first-line molecular test under NTEP and is particularly useful where drug-resistant TB is suspected.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. CBNAAT is a cartridge-based nucleic acid amplification test that detects MTB DNA and simultaneously identifies mutations in the rpoB gene associated with rifampicin resistance — all within approximately 2 hours. This is a major advantage over conventional culture for rapid identification of drug-resistant TB.
